observations.source: Public Millimeters wraps u16. After profile validation, validate_breastplate calls Anime validation before its outer 1–20 wall-thickness check. If earlier Anime predicates pass, the lap-lift relation multiplies the raw gauge by two. The selected loader parses then calls validation; selected device entry also validates, subject to preceding caller work.
observations.condition: An otherwise suitable Anime input with raw gauge at least 32768 reaches overflowing u16 multiplication before the outer gate if preceding checks pass. Depending on overflow-check configuration this can panic or wrap; no caller, input, parse, build configuration, device or runtime outcome is established. If multiplication wraps, the lap-lift comparison can reject; if it passes, an intervening guard can reject, and the later 1–20 wall-thickness gate necessarily rejects such a gauge if reached. Invalid mesh admission is not established.

observations.source: Warmup clones a Solid breastplate and swaps in default Anime while retaining wall thickness. Default Anime lap lift is 7 mm; for any otherwise valid Solid gauge 4–20, 7 is less than twice that gauge. The selected cuirass route dispatches to breastplate generation and later device record validates the alternate after prior device and surface stages.
